data.gender_notes: Mustakim is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mustakim is a Hindi name that means 'reliable' or 'firm'. In Sanskrit, the name is derived from the word 'mushti', which means 'palm' or 'grip'. The name signifies someone who holds on firmly to their beliefs and values. The name Mustakim carries the meaning “Reliable, Firm” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Parents who choose Mustakim usually hope their child will grow to embody reliable, firm and live with faith, good character and purpose.
